title: Tischkarte question file
description: One YAML file per category per language: questions/{lang}/{category}.yaml. Each file is a flat list of question entries. Contributors omit `id` and `added`; `tools/validate.py --fix` assigns them. See CONTRIBUTING.md.

id.description: q- + first 8 hex chars of SHA-256 of `lang|category|normalized text`. Assigned by validate.py --fix, never hand-written. Stable forever once assigned; later typo edits do NOT change the id.

text.description: The question. 10-140 characters, must end with a terminator from the language's config block (plus optional closing quote/bracket), no newlines, no leading/trailing whitespace, one question per entry.

tags.description: Optional, from the controlled vocabulary in x-tischkarte.tags. Tag keys are global English identifiers; translated labels live in the website's i18n.ts.

origin.description: Optional lineage link: the id of an existing question in another language that this one adapts. Never required — languages are independent corpora (docs/LANGUAGES.md).

author.description: Optional free-text credit. Courtesy only, no legal claim — all questions are CC0.

added.description: ISO date the entry was merged. Set by validate.py --fix.

x-tischkarte.description: Project config consumed by tools/validate.py and tools/build_*.py. Not part of the JSON Schema vocabulary.
